Why "Car Wash Near Me" Doesn't Really Work in Crofton

Crofton is a small waterfront community built around the pulp mill and the ferry terminal to Salt Spring Island, and it just doesn't have a dedicated car wash the way Duncan does. So the search results either send you 15-20 minutes out of town or point you at a coin-op bay that does nothing for salt film, brake dust, or the sap and bird droppings from the trees along the Seawalk. A quick rinse doesn't touch any of that. It just moves the grime around and leaves streaks.
What a Mobile Detail Actually Covers

We show up with our own water tank, generator, and products, so there's no hose bib or outlet required on your end. That matters in Crofton especially, where a lot of homes near the waterfront deal with salt air off the harbour that speeds up oxidation on clear coat and corrosion on wheel wells and exhaust hardware faster than vehicles parked further inland in places like Cobble Hill.

content.text: Serving Crofton Alongside the Rest of the Valley

We're already running regular routes between Duncan, Ladysmith, and Crofton, so fitting in a driveway appointment near the mill or down by Osborne Bay Park isn't a scheduling headache on our end. If your vehicle sits outside near the water full-time, we'd suggest a sealant over a basic wax - it holds up better against salt spray and makes the next wash faster and cheaper for you.
